definitions.gloss: geographical; relating to geography or physical location
definitions.explanation: Pertaining to physical location, terrain, or geographic distribution. Used to describe factors, conditions, or characteristics that are determined by where something is located on the earth.

examples.japanese: {地理的|ちりてき}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地理的|ちりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧だ。
examples.english: Geographically, Japan is a country with many earthquakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地理的|ちりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要所|ようしょ}→要所：16575_yousho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}している→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧。
examples.english: Geographically, this town is located at a key transportation junction.

examples.japanese: {地理的|ちりてき}な⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Although the geographical distance is short, the cultures and languages differ greatly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分布|ぶんぷ}→分布：00021_bunpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地理的|ちりてき}な⟦{偏|かたよ}り→偏り：05774_katayori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{南|みなみ}{半球|はんきゅう}→南半球：19054_minamihankyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The distribution of this plant has a geographical bias and is found only in the Southern Hemisphere.

notes:
{地理的|ちりてき} is a na-adjective formed from ⟦{地理|ちり}→地理：01669_chiri⟧ (geography) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (the productive suffix that creates adjectives meaning "-ical / pertaining to"). It means "geographical" — relating to physical location, terrain, or spatial distribution.

CONJUGATION (na-adjective):
- Modifier (before noun): {地理的|ちりてき}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (geographical conditions)
- Predicate: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地理的|ちりてき}だ (rare; usually as adverb or modifier)
- Adverbial: {地理的|ちりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — geographically
- Negative: {地理的|ちりてき}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {地理的|ちりてき}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧
- Past: {地理的|ちりてき}だった
- Te-form: {地理的|ちりてき}で

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地理的|ちりてき}⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: geographical conditions
- {地理的|ちりてき}⟦{要因|よういん}→要因：05581_youin⟧: geographical factor
- {地理的|ちりてき}な⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧: geographical location
- {地理的|ちりてき}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: geographical distance
- {地理的|ちりてき}⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧: geographical features
- {地理的|ちりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧ / ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧: geographically close / far
- {地理的|ちりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧: geographically advantageous

USAGE:
- The adverbial form {地理的|ちりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is especially common — often paired with ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧, ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧, ⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧, ⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧, or ⟦{離|はな}れている→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧.
- Use to contrast physical/spatial factors with other dimensions (⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧ historical, ⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧ political, ⟦{文化的|ぶんかてき}→文化的：05688_bunkateki⟧ cultural, etc.).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{地理|ちり}→地理：01669_chiri⟧: geography
- ⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧: topography, terrain
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: region, area
- {地政学|ちせいがく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: geopolitical (more narrow, political-strategic sense)
